Definition: Chanun, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hanun = "gracious"; 1) son of Nahash and king of Ammon who dishonoured David's ambassadors and lost the subsequent war with David; 2) a man who, with the people of Zanoah, repaired the ravine gate in the wall of Jerusalem; 3) the 6th son of Zalaph, who also assisted in the repair of the wall of Jerusalem, apparently on the east side
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
